verdict.rationale: Render documents workspace webhooks that notify other systems when specific service events occur, such as a deploy starting or a service scaling down. It also supports streaming telemetry to external tools. Together these let a devops lead route event-driven notifications into chat or alerting tools, but only with extra integration work. Missing for 10: native chat (e.g. Slack) or email notification channels, alert rules on metric thresholds or custom conditions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of alerting workflows.
